doc.title: Quincy Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Clifford Brown: begging Hampton to hire him, Gigi Gryce and Benny Golson
summary: Jones recalls losing Clifford Brown at 25, hearing him with Tiny Bradshaw, and asking Hampton to hire Clifford, Gigi Gryce and Benny Golson from Tadd Dameron's band, offering his own salary.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: 25 years old we lost him. Imagine what he would have been 40? He was a killer at 20. We were the ones – I remember us begging Hamp. We heard him with Tiny Bradshaw first. I think Coltrane was with him too.

Yeah. Then when we saw Tadd Dameron in Atlantic City, and he went in Tadd’s band – Gigi, Benny Golson, and Clifford. We said, “Hamp, please. Take my salary.” Whatever it is. It was $17 a night. “Just get these guys, please.” And he got the three of them. I love Hamp for that. I sit next to Brownie for a year. It was like an experience beyond description. Art Farmer. And Benny.
They were taken away from us too early.
They were taken away from us way too early.
Yeah, they were. Benny’s still here.
Oh yes. Well, that’s good. There’s that.
